user.title: Add Gira System 3000 device
user.description: Choose the device type, enter the Bluetooth MAC address of the Gira device and a name. A shutter control ("Jal+Schaltuhr") is connected and paired once to check that it can be reached, so it must be in pairing mode. A room thermostat is only read from its Bluetooth broadcasts, it just has to be seen by an adapter or proxy.

data_description.address: The MAC address as shown in the Home Assistant Bluetooth monitor, e.g. AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.
data_description.name: The name of the device in Home Assistant.

name.title: Set up Gira shutter controller
name.description: A Gira shutter controller was discovered. Put it into pairing mode, choose a name and submit. The device is connected and paired once to check that it can be reached.

data_description.name: The name of the device in Home Assistant.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the device. Make sure it is in pairing mode and within range of your Bluetooth adapter or proxy.
error.device_not_found: The device is not seen by any Bluetooth adapter or proxy. Check the address, the power supply and the range.
error.invalid_address: This is not a valid MAC address. Use the format AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.

abort.already_in_progress: A setup for this device is already in progress.

device_not_found.message: {name} ({address}) is currently not seen by any Bluetooth adapter or proxy. Check the range and the power supply.

command_timeout.message: Timed out after {timeout} s while communicating with {name} ({address}). Check that the Bluetooth adapter or proxy is online and in range.

command_failed.message: Failed to connect to {name} ({address}) or send the command: {error}

schedule_format.message: Invalid day schedule "{value}". Format: temperature,HH:MM,temperature,..., e.g. 5,06:00,21,18:00,5 (odd number of values, decimal point instead of comma).

schedule_temperature_step.message: The temperature {value} must be a multiple of {step} °C.

schedule_time_order.message: The time {value} must be after the previous one (ascending, after 00:00).

schedule_too_many.message: The week schedule needs {count} switch points, the thermostat stores at most {max}.

schedule_incomplete.message: The week schedule of the device is not known yet. Read it from the device first or enter all seven days.

schedule_read_failed.message: The time program of {name} could not be read.
